path.aria-label: v10 controller · useful throughput = verified and discarded logical MiB/s · measurements at block boundaries
CPU busy %, verified MiB/s, backing MiB/s
Reduce by one increment; halve at/below start.
Start 4 threads per allowed logical CPU.
≥ best rate → increase and measure again
< best rate → settle at exact best count
Reference is rate of selected thread count.
Choose lowest count within 5% of best.
CPU backoff overrides throughput tuning. Re-enter the active mode after each valid measurement; stop when all data is verified. No-progress watchdog: 300 s.
